data: Connasse, princesse des coeurs (The Parisian Bitch, Princess of Hearts)

Camilla, 30 ans Connasse née, se rend compte qu’elle n’a pas la vie qu’elle mérite et décide que le seul destin à sa hauteur est celui d’une altesse royale. (Thirty-year-old Camilla, born a bitch, realizes that she doesn't have the life she deserves and decides that the only destiny worthy of her is that of a royal princess.)
